name: Enterprise Agent Skills Hub
description: Unified Catalog of 27 Specialized Skills for Autonomous AI Agents in Enterprise Software Quality Engineering, Performance, and Architecture.

skills.name: Agent Orchestration Multi-Agent Optimize
skills.summary: Profile, benchmark, and orchestrate multi-agent test workloads and token throughput.

skills.name: Antigravity Test Sentinel
skills.summary: Enforce verification-first discipline: blocks task completion until tests and quality gates pass.

skills.name: API Network Mocking & Interception
skills.summary: Intercept HTTP/GraphQL traffic, stub routes, and simulate chaos network failures.

skills.name: API Spec to E2E Matrix
skills.summary: Generate automated positive, boundary, and negative test matrices from OpenAPI specifications.

skills.name: Architecture Decision Records
skills.summary: Record, structure, and maintain technical Architecture Decision Records (ADRs).

skills.name: Auth Session and Cookie Manager
skills.summary: Manage browser authentication sessions, storageState, JWT tokens, and multi-role state.

skills.name: Backend Load And Stress Patterns
skills.description: Enterprise backend load, stress, and endurance test orchestration using k6 and Locust. Directs AI agents in modeling concurrent Virtual Users (VUs), establishing SLA threshold assertions (P95/P99 latency, throughput/RPS, error rate < 0.1%), executing stress break-point tests, and soak/endurance validation.
skills.summary: Orchestrate k6 and Locust backend load, stress, and SLA endurance test suites.

skills.name: Bats Testing Patterns
skills.summary: Test bash/sh scripts, CLI tools, and CI/CD pipelines with Bats.

skills.name: Clean POM Crafter
skills.summary: Build and refactor Clean POM Page Classes adhering to Flat Architecture standards.

skills.name: Code Refactoring Refactor Clean
skills.summary: Eliminate technical debt and refactor code using SOLID and Clean Code patterns.

skills.name: Database State Verifier and Seeder
skills.summary: Seed isolated test fixtures and assert database mutations across SQL and NoSQL.

skills.name: E2E Testing Patterns
skills.summary: Design robust multi-browser E2E test architectures, parallel sharding, and retry governance.

skills.name: Failure Autopsy and Healing
skills.summary: Triage test failures from JUnit XML/screenshots and heal broken Page Class locators.

skills.name: File and Report Validator
skills.summary: Validate downloaded and uploaded files (Excel, CSV, PDF) schemas and tabular integrity.

skills.name: Flaky Test Sentinel And Quarantine
skills.description: Enterprise flaky test detection, scoring, and automated quarantine governance. Detects non-deterministic test behavior via multi-run repetition (e.g., 5 iterations), computes flakiness index, isolates unstable tests from blocking CI/CD merges via quarantine tagging (@quarantine / @flaky), and tracks MTBF until remediation.
skills.summary: Detect non-deterministic flaky tests, calculate flakiness scores, and manage quarantine.

skills.name: GitHub Actions Templates
skills.summary: Create production-ready GitHub Actions workflows for automated test suites and CI/CD.

skills.name: Graphify Impact Analyzer
skills.summary: Analyze code change blast radius and scope impacted test cases via AST.

skills.name: Katalon CLI Runner
skills.summary: Execute headless Katalon and Gradle test runners with automatic driver cleanup.

skills.name: LAM Script Generator
skills.summary: Transform user stories and acceptance criteria into Clean POM automation scripts.

skills.name: Playwright Live Interaction
skills.summary: Probe live web DOM/AOM and verify selectors under 200ms using headless Playwright.

skills.name: Security DAST Sentinel
skills.description: Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST) and OWASP Top 10 automated verification for web apps and APIs. Audits security response headers (CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options), detects sensitive data leaks (PII, tokens, internal stacktraces), asserts BOLA/IDOR authorization boundaries via role token swapping, and validates CORS configurations.
skills.summary: Run dynamic security audits: OWASP Top 10, security headers, IDOR, and token leakage.

skills.name: SkillSpector Security Guard
skills.description: Autonomous security scanner for AI Agent skills, prompt instructions, and MCP tool configs. Detects 71 vulnerability vectors across 17 categories (Prompt Injection, Data Exfiltration, Privilege Escalation, Agent Snooping, Tool Poisoning, Behavioral AST). Powered by NVIDIA SkillSpector heuristics with Prohibition Context Guard.
skills.summary: Audit and verify AI agent skills, prompts, and MCP configurations against 71 vulnerability vectors inspired by NVIDIA SkillSpector.

skills.name: Self Healing Locator
skills.summary: Heal broken locators using semantic AOM diffing with Role, Label, and TestId hierarchy.

skills.name: Synthetic Test Data Generator
skills.summary: Generate idempotent, boundary-value synthetic test data with unique runtime timestamps.

skills.name: Token and Context Optimizer
skills.summary: Optimize prompt context, distill verbose logs, and prevent context rot in Antigravity.

skills.name: Visual Regression Sentinel
skills.summary: Run pixel and layout shift visual regression checks with anti-flake masking.

skills.name: WCAG Audit Patterns
skills.summary: Audit WCAG 2.2 accessibility (A/AA), keyboard navigation, and ARIA roles.

skills.name: Web Vitals and Performance Profiler
skills.summary: Measure Core Web Vitals (LCP, CLS, INP) and network waterfalls via CDP.
